newsitem.title: USA: Rhone-Poulenc, Maruwa in Japan venture.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc, Maruwa in Japan venture.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc Agro, a unit of Rhone-Poulenc SA, said Thursday that it and Maruwa Bio Chemical have agreed to establish, as of October 1, 1997, a joint venture to market agrochemicals products for the Japanese non-agricultural land and golf course markets.
The newly formed company, which will be named UNICAS KK and headquartered in Tokyo, will be 70 percent owned by Maruwa and 30 percent by Rhone-Poulenc Agro.
It said Rhone-Poulenc Yuka Agro KK, the 50 percent owned Japanese subsidiary of Rhone- Poulenc Agro, will contribute its portfolio of amenity products to the new company.
